description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the InfoArray class within the OrangeHRM maintenance DTO module. It sets up test cases to verify the behavior of getMatchArray() and getParameterArray() methods with different input arrays.

classes.name: InfoArrayTest
classes.description: Test class for the InfoArray data transfer object, verifying its methods and behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes two InfoArray instances with different configurations for testing.

methods.name: testGetMatchArray
methods.description: Tests that getMatchArray() returns the expected match array based on the input.

methods.name: testGetParameterArray
methods.description: Tests that getParameterArray() returns the expected parameter array, or null when not set.
